text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py (P1): it inserts the repo root into sys.path, loads the original outbox via sent_messages() and the gateway results via delivery_status(), and for each SMS whose status is exactly 'failed' re-queues it with queue_sms(household_id, template_id, params) using the original template and params, so a new unique ID is assigned and one line is appended to outbox/sms.jsonl.
